notes: Partition verified: 18 source and 21 target IDs used exactly once.

s016 βάθη keeps *deep things* whole and heads on *deep* under rule 66, the noun's own English being an adjective-plus-generic-noun rendering of one Greek noun, with the article taking a bare *the* under rule 19. Reading it under rule 102, with *the things* to the article and a bare *deep* to the noun, remains defensible; it is refused here because rule 102's configuration is a supplied nominal standing in front of the article's own noun (τοῦ κυρίου → *the kingdom of*, τὰ ἐπιτήδεια → *the things* and *needful*), whereas *things* here follows the word that glosses the lexeme.
s012 πάντα is anarthrous, so *all things* rides whole on the quantifier headed on *all* under rule 17's anarthrous clause; contrast the articular τὰ πάντα at 1CO.2.15, which rule 17 splits.
The supplied object *them* is folded onto ἀπεκάλυψεν, the verb that requires it in English, no antecedent token standing in this verse to take it.

Variant SBLGNT.1CO.2.10.v006 selected r01 for s002, giving the ASV's *But*; the printed *For* note is not followed. v007 (underdetermined, r00-base) and v008 (selected r00-base) do not affect the English.
